questions.question: God promised to gather His scattered people Israel. How did He say He would keep them?

answers.text: As a shepherd keeps his flock
As a king keeps his army
As a farmer keeps his field

questions.question: In Jeremiah's message, Rachel weeps for her children and refuses to be comforted. Why is she weeping?
God told the weeping Rachel that her children would return from the land of the enemy. True or false?
God told His people Israel that His love for them would run out someday. True or false?
